question: Does transfer-aware ranking improve held-out utility when ranking decisions genuinely diverge?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: transfer-aware ranker improves over frequency-only and no-transfer; H0: no incremental improvement
primary_estimand_or_observation: Paired held-out utility difference by independent task/seed cluster; ranking disagreement diagnostic required
success_boundary: Pass only if predeclared primary effect clears SESOI and 95% cluster interval in expected direction; otherwise inconclusive/contradicted per charter

question: Does SCV improve skill-selection decisions when good, bad, and neutral candidates compete?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: SCV improves selected-set future utility; H0: no incremental decision value
primary_estimand_or_observation: Held-out selected-set utility/regret under fixed capacity, measured on independent outcomes
required_comparators: Always-create under same capacity; random; frequency/reuse heuristic
success_boundary: SCV must beat required alternatives under frozen paired endpoint and replication; selection divergence is a prerequisite

question: When does abstraction beat episodic memory, and when does a hybrid help?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: abstract skills add value on unseen compositions/contexts beyond exact replay; H0: retrieval is sufficient
primary_estimand_or_observation: Task success and cost/utility on held-out novel combinations under matched storage/query/compute budgets
required_comparators: Pure episode retrieval; skill abstraction; hybrid; no-learning
success_boundary: Claim abstraction advantage only on preregistered non-replay cases with matched budgets and independent held-out outcomes

question: Does a capability score predict external behavioral capability beyond prior performance and exposure?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: score adds predictive value on independent novel-task battery; H0: no incremental prediction
primary_estimand_or_observation: Out-of-sample prediction of independent task success/breadth/persistence beyond baseline ability and experience count
required_comparators: Prior-performance-only; exposure/frequency baseline; simpler portfolio counts
success_boundary: Pass only with preregistered incremental predictive effect above SESOI and independent replication; not based on score components alone

question: Does IG predict an independent future-learning or adaptation target?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: IG adds predictive value beyond prior performance/experience; H0: internal index has no external validity
primary_estimand_or_observation: Out-of-sample prediction of future learning efficiency/adaptation on independent tasks
required_comparators: Baseline ability; experience count; C_t/CGR and simple alternatives
success_boundary: Pass only on an external criterion with incremental predictive validity and replication; otherwise relabel/retire intelligence construct

question: Can the ARC mechanism chain activate with broader, protocol-conformant representation?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: ARC tasks yield valid invariants/skills/transfer/capability and improve held-out accuracy; H0: chain remains inactive or adds no benefit
primary_estimand_or_observation: Stage activation plus paired held-out exact-task performance; demo-fit coverage reported separately
required_comparators: Frozen no-learning; frequency/simple DSL; memory; relevant compression baseline
success_boundary: Gold requires valid downstream stages plus positive held-out task benefit vs no-learning under a frozen split and budget

question: Do core results replicate under independent generators, vocabularies, and trace implementations?
hypothesis_or_null: H1: core mechanisms persist; H0: results depend on original generator/trace vocabulary
primary_estimand_or_observation: Replication of predeclared IDT/SCT/transfer outcomes on out-of-generator data
required_comparators: Original method vs simple baselines under identical test conditions
success_boundary: General claim requires independent replication with same direction and prespecified success gate
